description:
The physical AI industry converged for MACHINA Summit on July 7, 2026, and this is what it looked like.

MACHINA Summit brought together 2,200+ attendees and 85+ speakers from the world's most consequential physical AI companies for Europe's leading Physical AI Summit.

The inaugural edition delivered landmark announcements, live robot demonstrations, and conversations that will shape the direction of the industry for years to come.

This is MACHINA 2026.
